title: ROOSTER
intro: The chicken is the only bird in the Chinese Zodiac, and its distant ancestor was domesticated and evolved into the present domestic chicken. Since ancient times, the chicken has been regarded as the “bird of five virtues”. People have interpreted the animal characteristics of the chicken, associating them to symbolic meaning, especially trustworthiness and punctuality. Chickens have high reproductive capacity and survival rate, being industrious by nature, foraging for food all day long. Despite its relative small size and strength, the chicken is bold and courageous in critical moments, and is even believed to have some kind of divine ability to ward off disasters and evil spirits. The Rooster is the tenth in the Chinese zodiac. and its corresponding earthly branches is “You”.

In 1993, 2005 and 2017, Macao CTT issued stamps for the Year of the Rooster. On the stamps and first day covers for the first zodiac cycle, there is a brave-looking rooster standing upright with its chest puffed out. In the second cycle of zodiac souvenir sheet designed by Lio Man Cheong, the protagonist, on the other hand, takes on a more robust and plump shape. Another 2017 Year of the Rooster souvenir sheet, designed by Lam Chi Ian, features a colourful rooster crowing amidst the fireworks on a diamond-shaped stamp, the background of the souvenir sheet also features the traditional Portuguese Barcelos Rooster, and greetings of New Year's seasonal greetings in both Chinese and Portuguese. In addition, the Year of the Rooster postage label designed by Anita Fung, with the coin-shape postmark, was affixed on the commemorative cover for the “100th Anniversary of the Postal Savings”.

Canada Post issued Year of the Rooster stamps in 2005 and again in 2017. According to the designer, the design of 2005 was a computer-generated effect. The elements such as the feathers and crown of the rooster are designed at first, then decompose and combine them to create images of various shades of ink and colour. Finally, gainst the gilded background of light yellow, there stand a embossed rooster with tail up. In the souvenir sheet issued in 2017, using bright red as the main colour to highlight a rooster, sketched with golden line, with its chest puffed out with pride, This wavy line omposition is a rare design.
